statements.statement: The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has recent episodes of transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9)
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and brief episodes of neurological deficits
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The procedure supports optimization of rate and rhythm control strategies
